question: Should ClawHub/OpenClaw continue to support the legacy `https://molt.bot/install.sh` zsh installer, or should that path be redirected or retired in favor of current install commands?
rationale: The failing implementation is not in current source, while current docs and UI point to maintained install commands; automation cannot choose ownership or retirement for a hosted legacy setup path.

options.title: Redirect or retire the legacy installer
options.body: Point users to the maintained `openclaw` and `clawhub` install commands and state the supported Node range for current setup paths.

options.title: Support and harden the installer
options.body: Bring the installer source under traceable ownership, reproduce the macOS/Homebrew zsh failure, and guard unmatched cleanup globs.

options.title: Wait for fresh reproduction
options.body: Keep the issue waiting on author until there is evidence that the current hosted installer still fails today.

recommendation.title: Redirect or retire the legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point users to the maintained `openclaw` and `clawhub` install commands and state the supported Node range for current setup paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest current routing owner from blame on the maintained CLI package, install command, docs, and release surface.
